The frozen evaluation_contract.json:24 pre-registered, BEFORE any outcome: 'exactly 3 observed diagnostic slots; a slot is consumed when the cell's scored computation STARTS; never reassigned, never force-filled'. The runner increments observed_slots only after the BINDABLE_NOW check and before the score call (score/score_runner.py:268-269) and logs 'no slot consumed' for NOT_RUN_DATA_BLOCKED (:266). 'Chinh xac 3 observed diagnostic cells' in plan section 1 fixes the budget DENOMINATOR and the never-reassigned law; the same sentence's 'never force-filled' clause and plan section 4's fail-closed BLOCKED_DATA_OR_COST pre-registration make consuming no slot for a data-blocked family the lawful honest reading, not an evasion. TECHNICAL_FAILURE correctly still consumes its slot (:268, contract 'every computed cell consumes a slot even if reporting later fails').
6_trial_accounting.caveat: Finding F3 means a real run would consume one of the three slots on a preventable CNG2 loader-signature crash. Lawful but wasteful; must be fixed before GO.

findings.finding: score_fxng3 post-processing iterates the engine's position-set DICT, not its rows list: score/score_runner.py:208-211 `rows = [... for r in pos]` yields the 17 top-level dict KEYS (strings); dict(zip(POSITION_ROW_COLUMNS, key)) fabricates garbage rows; the measured filter then selects 0 rows, so _metrics_from_rows would return n_trades=0, net_pnl=0.0 and the runner would record verdict FLAT — a silently bogus outcome artifact (reproduction would still 'pass' because the garbage digest is deterministic).
findings.evidence: Empirically demonstrated by this audit on a SYNTHETIC fxng3_engine.build_positions output: 'runner rows length: 17 (== number of DICT KEYS)', 'sample garbage row: {"event_id": "s", ...}', 'measured count: 0'. Correct usage: pos['rows'].
findings.remediation: Fix score/score_runner.py:208-211 to consume pos['rows'] and re-run the golden suites + a synthetic dry-run of the orchestrator scoring path before any GO. No outcome exists, so the fix leaks nothing.

findings.finding: The measured-row filter accepts only status in ('OK','MEASURED',None) (score/score_runner.py:210), but the engine's filled statuses are exactly MEASURED and FORCE_FLAT_FOLD_BOUNDARY — force-flat rows carry real entry/exit fills, net and costs and would be silently EXCLUDED from every aggregate (under-counted outcome, wrong PF/win-rate/folds).
findings.evidence: Empirically demonstrated on synthetic data: engine statuses ['FORCE_FLAT_FOLD_BOUNDARY'], 'runner filter keeps: 0 of 1 rows with real fills'. Engine status vocabulary: fxng3_engine.py:615-622.
findings.remediation: Filter on the engine's actual filled statuses (MEASURED, FORCE_FLAT_FOLD_BOUNDARY) or on net is-not-None.

findings.finding: score_cng2 calls eng.load_panel(_RUN/'data'/'cng2', s) and eng.load_funding_series(..., s) (score/score_runner.py:159-164): both loaders take (path_to_file, expected_sha256=None), so the second positional argument passes the SYMBOL as a digest and the DIRECTORY as the path — guaranteed IsADirectoryError at E-phase. CNG2 would burn one of the three observed slots on a TECHNICAL_FAILURE caused by a wiring bug (slot consumption is lawful but wasteful and avoidable).
findings.evidence: Empirically demonstrated: 'CNG2 load_panel(dir, sym) raises: IsADirectoryError [Errno 21] Is a directory: data/cng2' (same for load_funding_series).
findings.remediation: Load the committed panel CSVs and funding_history.json by their real paths (and pass their pinned sha256 values, see F5).

findings.finding: _metrics_from_rows (score/score_runner.py:110-149) implements a SUBSET of the frozen evaluation_contract metrics_per_cell. Missing entirely: max_drawdown, exposure (days/bars in market), turnover, concentration, CAGR (FXNG3 window 7y and CNG2 window 1y both allow it), net_pnl_tier_1.0; profit_factor is computed on the NET sums only while the contract names the GROSS-winning/gross-losing ratio as primary (net 'also reported'); cost_attribution lacks the cost_contract reporting fields (total cost bps, cost as % of gross, net/gross ratio); the CNG2 benchmark_control_comparison (vs CTL-SHIFTBOUNDMINUS2H + CTL-FUNDLEVEL arms, contract-mandated) is hard-coded None with 'arms runnable post-GO' (score/score_runner.py:191). Running E with this runner would write a score_summary.json that silently omits frozen contract metrics.
findings.remediation: Extend the aggregation to the full frozen metric set (and wire the two CNG2 control arms through the same sanctioned builder path) BEFORE the owner GO; no outcome is affected because none exists.
